capital.venue: Alpaca paper accounts for equity and futures sleeves; locally simulated fills for crypto perpetuals
capital.notes: Three sleeves reconcile against dedicated Alpaca paper accounts. The crypto sleeve is filled locally against point-in-time venue data and is never presented as broker-executed.

period.calendar: UTC daily marks; sleeves trade on their own venue calendars

costs.notes: One shared transaction-cost model prices every fill; the engine never computes a cost itself.

selection.trial_unit: first immutable record per hypothesis identity, deduplicated across every durable ledger
selection.deflation_method: Deflated Sharpe against the expected maximum of the counted trial union. Not applied to this record because the forward sample cannot support a Sharpe estimate yet.

risk.exposure_notes: The realised figure is descriptive of a short sample. The model estimate is not established by live evidence.

provenance.signature_scheme: Ed25519 over an append-only hash chain

establishes: A 18-observation paper record with broker reconciliation on 3 sleeves.
That every published figure traces to a hash-bound artifact.
does_not_establish: A forward Sharpe ratio. 252 observations are required to estimate one and this record has 18.
An expected maximum drawdown. The realised figure describes a short sample and the model estimate is not live evidence.
